name: GAIB sAID
oneLiner: sAID is GAIB's ERC-4626 AI-financing NAV vault funded by AID; current on-chain unstaking uses a 30-day cooldown and a liquidity-dependent FIFO queue.
collateral: AID staked into GAIB's ERC-4626 sAID vault; vault capital is deployed into AI infrastructure financings (GPUs, robotics, and related compute) plus a stable reserve buffer of T-bills and stablecoins for liquidity
pegMechanism: sAID is minted by staking AID at the staking NAV rather than pegged to $1. At Ethereum block 26099923 on 2026-10-01, the current implementation burns shares through unstake(uint256), records a loss-adjusted AID claim, and pays AID through processUnstakeQueue(uint256) in FIFO order after a 30-day cooldown, subject to operator-managed available liquidity; partial fills are possible and cooldown expiry is not a maximum completion guarantee. Instant ERC-4626 withdrawals are disabled while cooldown is positive. Issuer documentation describes monthly cohorts, but the reviewed callable implementation uses a request-relative cooldown. AID onward redemption is a separate liquidity- and limit-dependent path; DEX sales depend on market liquidity.

slice.name: AID vault shares and AI infrastructure financing portfolio

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: sAID is the AI-infrastructure financing vault layer and intentionally departs from the liquid AID parent reserve archetype.
